items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: But not after he left my band.

ctx.x: Oh, well, that's where he's from. Yeah. But not after he left my band. Yeah, I guess so. He's going back to before he came to my band and Reserva and up in there. There was nine brothers, all of them were musicians. Yeah. Including the daddy.
Now, Cartrell, we know pretty well, we've got his life story now. So that's the reeds and the brass, the rhythm, Lloyd Glenn.
Well, there's some, a lot of them that you left out that came in later days. Yeah. But you're going to be the original, right?
